title: Tomato-Potato Late Blight in the Home Garden
content: Tomato late blight is caused by the water mold Phytophthora infestans. Penn State Extension describes pale-green to brown lesions on infected plants, downy white growth under suitable conditions, and greasy-appearing spots on fruit. The source emphasizes that the disease can affect both tomato and potato.
author: Beth K. Gugino, Sara R. May, and Alan A. MacNab
